title: Subgroup transfer factors the index action on group homology
statement: Let k be a commutative ring, G a group with a finite-type structure, A a k-linear G-representation, H a subgroup equipped with a finite-type structure, and n a natural number. Use the common universe required by groupHomology. There exist k-linear maps T : Hₙ(G,A) → Hₙ(H,Res_H A) and P : Hₙ(H,Res_H A) → Hₙ(G,A) such that P(T(x)) = [G:H] • x for every x, where • is repeated addition. No normality of H or finiteness of A is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Fintype G] (A : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H] (n : ℕ), ∃ T : groupHomology A n →ₗ[k] groupHomology (Rep.res H.subtype A) n, ∃ P : groupHomology (Rep.res H.subtype A) n →ₗ[k] groupHomology A n, ∀ x : groupHomology A n, P (T x) = H.index • x
